context:
This is an excerpt - if you would like to read the full paper, it is [here](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2404.10072) and takes roughly 1 hour and 30 minutes. We have excerpted Section 8: The Troubling Implications of Legal Rationales for Robot Rights.

_Makes a case against the applicability of rights to AI systems._
